北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，出行要小心。湿度高体感暖，保持好心情哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy, please take care when going out. High humidity makes it feel warm, keep a good mood!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴热，体感 34℃ 炎热。多补水防晒，注意防暑哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and hot, feeling 34℃. Stay hydrated, use sunscreen, and prevent heatstroke.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 37℃ 酷热！务必多补水，注意防暑降温。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, but feels scorching 37℃! Please drink plenty of water and cool down.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，体感 34℃ 闷热。出门记得带伞，注意防潮哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feeling 34℃ muggy. Take an umbrella and mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 34℃ 炎热。请多饮水，做好防晒措施。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels 34℃ hot. Please drink plenty of water and take sun protection.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 35℃ 酷热。多喝水，防暑别忘哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels 35℃ extremely hot. Drink plenty of water and don't forget heatstroke prevention!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 34℃ 闷热。湿度大，记得开窗通风哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feeling 34℃ muggy. High humidity, remember to ventilate your home.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 35℃ 炎热。风力小，注意防晒补水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feeling 35℃ hot. Light breeze, remember sun protection and hydration.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 31℃ 闷热。湿度极高，请注意除湿防潮。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feeling 31℃ muggy. Extremely high humidity, please dehumidify and prevent dampness.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，气温 30℃ 适宜。湿度较低，注意补水保湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, 30℃ and pleasant. Low humidity, remember to hydrate and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴热，气温 34℃ 偏高。湿度低，多喝水，谨防中暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and hot, 34℃. Low humidity, drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 29℃ 较暖。湿度高，注意开窗通风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, feeling 29℃ warm. High humidity, remember to ventilate your home.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 30℃ 适宜。微风拂面，享受美好时光。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels 30℃ pleasant. Gentle breeze, enjoy your beautiful time.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温 22℃ 凉爽。湿度适中，记得带件外套哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, 22℃ and cool. Moderate humidity, remember to bring a jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 31℃ 闷热。湿度高，注意防晒多饮水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feeling 31℃ muggy. High humidity, remember sun protection and hydration.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 28℃ 舒适。湿度较高，保持衣物干爽哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels 28℃ pleasant. High humidity, keep your clothes dry.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 28℃ 舒适。湿度较大，注意衣物防潮。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels 28℃ pleasant. High humidity, mind your clothes' dampness.
